Q1.headline: Customers expect service reliability, accurate pricing, and clear recourse for issues
Q1.answer: Users view bookings as contracts requiring punctual arrivals, advertised work quality, and consistent pricing. They also seek accountability and recourse when service promises are not met.

Q2.headline: Service triggers range from urgent appliance breakdowns to planned seasonal maintenance
Q2.answer: Triggers include appliance failures, moving, seasonal changes, and upcoming events. Needs vary between urgent repairs and scheduled periodic services, though findings are based on a small sample.

Q3.headline: Customers choose between Urban Company, local professionals, and brand service centres
Q3.answer: Users often switch to local independent professionals for small repairs or brand centres for warranty issues. Other platforms are primarily considered through community discussions on Reddit.

Q4.headline: Service quality drives returns while trust failures and pricing deter repeat bookings
Q4.answer: Repeat bookings are driven by professional service providers and platform convenience. However, customers may return despite negative experiences due to habit or limited alternatives.

Q5.headline: Customers prefer local independent professionals for lower costs and direct accountability
Q5.answer: Users primarily seek local providers and other platforms to save money and ensure reliability for small tasks. Evidence suggests customers value the direct relationships and accountability offered by independent technicians.

Q6.headline: Recourse failures and pricing issues drive churn while professional quality drives retention
Q6.answer: Returning customers prioritize professional quality, punctuality, and trust. Conversely, non-returning customers frequently cite issues with recourse, pricing, and fulfillment. Note that some returning customers express negative or mixed sentiments.

Q7.headline: Service categories show distinct pain points and review source impacts sentiment.
Q7.answer: Specific categories over-index on issues like incomplete work, damage, or installation. Review source is a significant driver of feedback type, though category comparisons rely on small sample sizes.

Q8.headline: Unmet needs center on experiential failures and service reliability issues.
Q8.answer: Customers primarily struggle with refund processes, payment recovery, and accessing human support. Issues also persist regarding warranty fulfillment, arrival reliability, and pricing transparency.
